source.raw_records: preserved outside the repository at the three owner-supplied /tmp paths

assessment.cause: Two defects combined: macOS null-filename FSEvents notifications entered both watcher callbacks as relevant hints, and a timed-out or cancelled waiter left an authority scan running while final or later sync reads started another scan
assessment.repair: ignore null, empty, and invalid watcher filenames; retain exact relevant filenames and five-second authority cadence; single-flight complete Task-projection reads per CoordinationObservationService and Team so orphaned, final, and later reads join until settlement
assessment.release_blocker: A new-source real macOS eight-Worker stress and recovery E2E must remain bounded, show no overlapping Beads children from sync reads, and show no FSEvents feedback storm before release.
